The workshop has three parts.
- Part one explains how vowels are formed in the mouth.
- Part two covers the minerals found in the region.
- Part three is a short quiz.

Tips for commuters:
- Leave early to avoid the worst of the traffic on the ring road.
- Don't carry more than two bags.
- Check the timetable the night before.

Course outline:
- Week one introduces the basic tools of the trade.
- Week two looks at the history of the craft.
- Week three is a field trip.

Before you start:
- Make sure the power is switched off at the wall.
- Keep children away from the work area.
- Wear gloves at all times.

Our findings:
- Most patients recovered within a month of treatment.
- Side effects were rare and mild.
- Costs fell by a third.

Packing list:
- Bring a warm jacket for the evenings in the mountains.
- Pack at least two pairs of socks.
- Carry a small first-aid kit.

Rules of the club:
- Members must sign in at the front desk on arrival.
- Guests pay a small fee.
- Phones stay in the lockers.

What changed in this version:
- The menu now loads much faster on older phones.
- Several crashes were fixed.
- The icons were redrawn.
